title: Visual review
description: Machine-readable verdict of one review pass, at examples/<project>/revisions/<id>/visual-review.json. This is the file the autonomous loop reads to decide whether to iterate, stop, or hand over for approval; visual-review.md is the human rendering of the same pass and carries the prose, the component-by-component walkthrough and the quoted parity metric. Only decision-bearing fields are required here — everything descriptive stays optional so the Markdown remains the richer document.

schemaVersion.description: On-disk contract version for this artifact.

verdict.description: Loop control. READY_FOR_APPROVAL stops the loop and hands over to the user; REVISE means iterate on the highest-severity actionable mismatch; BLOCKED means the loop cannot make progress and must report why in failureCategory.

recommendation.description: The human-facing recommendation the Visual Review Agent has always emitted (skills/workflows/review-template/SKILL.md). Kept alongside `verdict` because the two answer different questions: this one advises the user, `verdict` drives the loop. Never write "APPROVED" — that is a revision status, not a recommendation.

score.description: Reference parity score. A signal, not a gate (docs/visual-review-loop.md) — the gate is the metric under `gate`.

iteration.description: 1-based position of this review inside one autonomous fix loop. Bounded by limits.maxIterations in config/pipeline.json.

comparedAgainst.description: What this pass was compared with, which follows from the scope's gate in config/pipeline.json: exact-diff and region-diff compare against the parent revision, visual-review compares against the reference image.

kind.description: Which gate the scope ends on. Vocabulary shared with config/pipeline.json → gates.

passed.description: Whether the gate's own rule was satisfied, independent of the softer parity score.

metric.description: The comparison metric quoted VERBATIM, e.g. "magick compare -metric AE => 0". skills/workflows/review-template/SKILL.md forbids paraphrasing it.

diffMask.description: Path to the saved diff mask, relative to the revision folder.

pages.description: Per-page evidence. Required in practice for the exact-diff and region-diff gates, where the AE number per page IS the verdict.

affected.description: True when this region is one the change was allowed to touch. Regions outside that set must report mismatchPixels 0.

regions.description: Per-region evidence for the region-diff gate.

gate.description: The deterministic half of the review. The model interprets; this records what was measured.

mismatches.description: Every difference found, ranked most severe first. Empty only when the render matches. skills/workflows/review-template/SKILL.md: every mismatch must be documented, and classifications outside the closed set must not be invented.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier for this mismatch, e.g. "header-height". Stable across iterations: repeating the same id is how limits.maxSameMismatchAttempts detects a loop that is not converging.

severity.description: Classification from docs/visual-accuracy-contract.md. ACCEPTED_LIMITATION is never assigned automatically — it requires a human note.

component.description: Named private render method that owns the region, e.g. "renderHeader". This is what the next iteration edits, and what changedComponents in revision.json records.

reason.description: What differs from the expected result, in one sentence.

action.description: The concrete next edit, e.g. "Reduce vertical padding". Required in spirit for anything the loop is expected to fix; omit only when the mismatch is accepted.

evidence.description: Paths backing the claim (diff mask, cropped comparison), relative to the revision folder.

largestMismatch.description: Id of the one mismatch the next iteration must fix. The loop fixes exactly one thing per pass, so naming it here removes the ambiguity of re-ranking the list.

failureCategory.description: Why the loop stopped. Required when verdict is BLOCKED. The enum is duplicated from config/pipeline.json and schemas/revision.schema.json rather than $ref-ed across files, because the validator compiles each schema standalone; scripts/test/pipeline-config.test.mjs asserts the three copies agree.

blockedDetail.description: What specifically blocks progress — the missing information, or the GraphCompose behaviour that was verified and cannot be worked around.

summary.description: One-paragraph summary. The long form lives in visual-review.md.

allOf.description: A BLOCKED verdict must say why, in the shared vocabulary.
REVISE means there is something to fix, so the list cannot be empty.
